name: contact-emails-to-zapier-table
description: Notion Contacts email edits -> index every Primary/Secondary email in the email->page-id Zapier Table; ADD a cross-contact email collision to "Possible duplicate of" (a review flag for a person — never "Duplicate of", which the Contact Merger Notion agent treats as an instruction to merge and delete); on trash, hand a merged-away contact's addresses to the survivor or delete them on a genuine delete; on restore, re-index them. Ignores pages from the other Core CRM Objects data sources.
